conditions: Module comments documented in the Developer Guide §4.2.4.1.
limitations: The rule concerns comment syntax in source code. Literal delimiters and Designer context help use their own documented rules.

triggers: Publisher edition or documentation correction, article representation drift, or contrary language-boundary evidence.

statement: In 1C:Enterprise 8.3.27 module source, `//` starts a comment through the end of that line. A comment can start a line or follow a statement on the same line.
